questions.q: What must happen to a transaction posted directly in Cash Management before it can be accounted into the General Ledger?
options: It must first be reconciled against the bank statement
It must be converted to a different currency
It must be included in a cash forecast
It must be approved by Receivables
questions.explain: Transactions like bank transfers and external transactions can only be accounted into the General Ledger once reconciled with the bank statement.

questions.q: What does the Create Accounting process do with a reconciled Cash Management transaction?
options: It deletes the transaction from the bank statement
It automatically reverses the transaction
It submits the transaction to Subledger Accounting, which generates the journal entry
It converts the transaction into a cash forecast row
questions.explain: Create Accounting submits the transaction to Oracle Fusion Subledger Accounting, which applies accounting rules and produces the journal entry.

questions.q: Who calculates any gain or loss from a currency exchange rate on a cross-currency bank transfer?
options: Cash Management, at the moment the transfer is first entered
Subledger Accounting, during the Create Accounting process
The bank itself, before the statement is loaded
No gain or loss is ever calculated for transfers
questions.explain: Subledger Accounting calculates any FX gain or loss during Create Accounting, not Cash Management at transaction entry.

questions.q: Why can the Cash to General Ledger Reconciliation report (Lesson 14) show a temporary difference even when nothing is actually wrong?
options: Because the report is always inaccurate
Because Cash Positioning overwrites the GL balance
Because bank statements are never loaded correctly
Because a transaction can be reconciled but not yet have gone through Create Accounting
questions.explain: A reconciled transaction awaiting its Create Accounting run produces exactly this kind of temporary, explainable gap.

questions.q: In the worked example, what triggered the journal entries for Harborview Metals Inc.'s $50,000.00 sweep?
options: The moment the transfer was first entered into the system
The Cash Forecasting template being updated
Both legs being reconciled to Friday's statements, followed by that evening's Create Accounting run
A manual journal entry typed directly into the General Ledger
questions.explain: Both the outflow and inflow legs had to reconcile first; only then did the scheduled Create Accounting run generate the journal entries.
